This tool preserves layouts, compositions, and spatial relationships while changing subjects or styles, useful for recreating scenes with different subjects.</image:caption>

      <image:title>News & Updates - Stability AI releases DeepFloyd IF, a powerful text-to-image model that can smartly integrate text into images - This generation flowchart represents a three-stage performance:</image:title>
      <image:caption>A text prompt is passed through the frozen T5-XXL language model to convert it into a qualitative text representation.  Stage 1: A base diffusion model transforms the qualitative text into a 64x64 image. This process is as magical as witnessing a vinyl record’s grooves turn into music. The DeepFloyd team has trained three versions of the base model, each with different parameters: IF-I 400M, IF-I 900M and IF-I 4.3B.  Stage 2: To ‘amplify’ the image, two text-conditional super-resolution models (Efficient U-Net) are applied to the output of the base model. The first of these upscale the 64x64 image to a 256x256 image. Again, several versions of this model are available: IF-II 400M and IF-II 1.2B.  Stage 3: The second super-resolution diffusion model is applied to produce a vivid 1024x1024 image. The final third stage model IF-III has 700M parameters. Note: We have not released this third-stage model yet; however, the modular character of the IF model allows us to use other upscale models – like the Stable Diffusion x4 Upscaler – in the third stage.</image:caption>
